name: Kitzbüheler Horn
beschreibung: The site of the historic hotel Kitzbüheler Horn is situated in Oberndorf in Tirol in the district of Wiesenschwang, directly at the foot of the prominent 1,996-meter Kitzbüheler Horn summit. Located in the scenic Leukental Valley between Kitzbühel and St. Johann in Tirol, this alpine setting has long served as an ideal gateway for hiking, cycling, and alpine skiing. The surrounding Kitzbühel Alps vacation region is famous for wide-open nature and prime access to the St. Johann and KitzSki winter arenas.
kurzbeschreibung: Alpine resort location at the base of the Kitzbüheler Horn mountain in Oberndorf in Tirol.
